what: Re-bump tail always runs classify/apply/changelog with no bump_type NONE gate
scenario_or_breakage: Bash skips apply_bump and ship_pr_commit_changelog_after_rebump when BUMP_TYPE=NONE; unconditional apply_bump can add a redundant Bump version commit and changelog work on no-op classifies
suggested_fix: Wrap steps 5–6 in bump_type != "NONE" and non-empty new_version (match scripts/ship-pr.sh ~3074–3087); stub a NONE path in test_rebase.py

what: Pre-pass adds auto-generated and LARCH_BUMP_FILES checkout_ours not in bash run_rebase_rebump
scenario_or_breakage: Bash only auto-resolves CHANGELOG paths and checkout --ours for plugin.json (path-guarded) version.go and go.sum; extra rules add scope and can mis-resolve paths bash would send to the fixer
suggested_fix: Limit the deterministic pre-pass to bash parity (CHANGELOG via changelog.auto_resolve; plugin.json / version.go / go.sum via checkout_ours); drop auto-generated and LARCH_BUMP_FILES unless a separate issue defines bump-commit detection

what: _resolve_conflicts says to build a fixer prompt from conflict-resolution.md while also calling launch_*-ci
scenario_or_breakage: Launch scripts already inject CONFLICT_CONTEXT and optional PLAN_CONTEXT; duplicating prompt assembly in rebase.py is extra surface and can drift from launch-cursor-ci.sh
suggested_fix: Have _resolve_conflicts only call agents.launch_tier / run_waterfall with role=resolve-conflict and conflict_files; delete prompt-building prose from the plan

what: rebase --skip on empty/already-applied is named but not tied to continue failure signals
scenario_or_breakage: rebase-push.sh continue failures return exit 3 with REBASE_ERROR text; blind skip can skip real failures (skills/implement/references/conflict-resolution.md ~110)
suggested_fix: After non-zero rebase_continue with no unmerged paths, skip only when combined stderr/stdout matches empty/already-applied patterns; otherwise Stalled; add a stub case in test_rebase.py

what: Version-regression guard uses base_remote/base_ref but apply_bump still hardcodes origin/main
scenario_or_breakage: Fork/upstream bases can disagree with apply_bump’s origin/main fetch and guards (python/version_bump.py ~566-578)
suggested_fix: [OUT_OF_SCOPE] Track for a later phase: thread base_remote/base_ref through apply_bump or document that Phase 3 targets the default origin/main layout only
